} .account-breakdown h3 { font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; } .breakdown-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.85rem; } .breakdown-row .bar-wrap { flex: 1; height: 22px; background: var(--input-bg); border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--border); } .breakdown-row .bar { height: 100%; border-radius: 999px; transition: width 0.3s ease; min-width: 2px; } .breakdown-row .bar.positive { background: var(--primary); } .breakdown-row .bar.warning { background: var(--warning); } .breakdown-row .bar.over { background: var(--danger); } .breakdown-row .breakdown-label { min-width: 120px; font-weight: 600; } .breakdown-row .breakdown-amount { min-width: 100px; text-align: right; font-weight: 500; } /* === MODAL === */ .modal-overlay { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4); z-index: 100; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 1rem; } .modal { background: var(--card-bg); border-radius: var(--radius); box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); width: 100%; max-width: 480px; max-height: 90vh; overflow-y: auto; } .modal-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 1rem 1.25rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); } .modal-header h3 { font-size: 1rem; } .modal-close { background: none; border: none; font-size: 1.5rem; cursor: pointer; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1; padding: 0.25rem; } .modal-body { padding: 1.25rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; } .modal-footer { padding: 1rem 1.25rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 0.5rem; } .inline-group { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; flex-wrap: wrap; } .inline-group input[type="number"] { width: 80px; } .inline-group select { width: auto; } .inline-group span { font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-muted); } .awareness-result, .whatif-result { padding: 0.75rem; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); font-size: 0.9rem; } .awareness-result { background: #fef3c7; border: 1px solid #fde68a; } .whatif-result { background: #ede9fe; border: 1px solid #c4b5fd; } input[type="range"] { width: 100%; accent-color: var(--accent); } /* === FOOTER === */ .app-footer { text-align: center; padding: 1.5rem; font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--text-muted); } .app-footer a { color: var(--primary); text-decoration: none; } /* === RESPONSIVE === */ @media (max-width: 640px) { .app-header { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; } .income-inputs { flex-direction: column; } .expenses-table th.col-amount:nth-child(n+4), .expenses-table td:nth-child(n+4):not(:nth-child(6)):not(:nth-child(7)) { /* Hide yearly on very small screens — users can scroll */ } main { padding: 1rem 0.5rem; } .card { padding: 1rem; } .summary-cards { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
